edition.title: De Exorcismis et Supplicationibus quibusdam, editio typica emendata 2004

passages.context: The report says the editio typica was published in 1999 after a Dicastery ordinary meeting on 20 January 1998. Exhaustion of that first printing occasioned a reprint with technical-typographical corrections in the form of the 2004 editio typica emendata.
passages.notes: This supports reprint character and correction category only. It is not a line-by-line collation of the 1999 and 2004 books.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The exact modern journal issue is publicly delivered by the responsible Holy See dicastery, but it contains modern editorial, typographic, and scholarly material and no artifact-level redistribution license was located. Online official availability alone is not repository redistribution permission.
